parsed.explanation: For a visitor, the surgical LGR requirement is resident-facing (rule 1) and no rejection of foreign passports, border screening, trans criminalisation, police targeting or trans-specific violence is documented. Documented social acceptance is strong: long-standing pride, a 3,000-person trans march, and description as regionally progressive. Counterweights are traveler-facing friction: 17% of reported discrimination occurred in restrooms/changing rooms and only 5 of 149 listed all-gender toilets met standards, plus rising anti-gender activity. No universal birth-sex facility or custody rule is documented, but no specific working visitor remedy/tribunal outcomes are shown either. This fits reduced-risk with nontrivial facility friction and uncertainty, below 0.75 where identity-based facility access and enforced remedies are documented.
